Appraisal, legal, survey and baseline report costs can be reimbursed, but only after an award is made.

decisions.decision: The Forest Legacy item stays on the agenda for the next meeting, and members will review the materials and the open space plan land inventory.

The chair will send a summary email to the select board and talk further with the donor and the buyer's attorney.

A member will check with the town planner whether drill holes in a stone wall are acceptable as monuments for the 250 Howard Street conveyance.

what_happened.line: The Open Space Committee voted by roll call to recommend that the town waive its right of first refusal on 360 Flat Hill Road.
Members had concluded the Chapter 61A purchase of 360 Flat Hill Road could not be pieced together in time; a funding gap remained beyond a donor's pledge.
The chair will send a summary email to the select board and talk further with the donor and the buyer's attorney.
The committee heard a Forest Legacy presentation, a cost-share federal program needing a local match, and held the item over to the next meeting.
A resident suggested a dedicated fund so the town can act on short Chapter 61A deadlines; the town-owned property list review was continued.

why_it_matters: The recommendation points toward the town not buying 360 Flat Hill Road, so that land could pass to a private buyer and leave town ownership; the select board still has to act on the committee's advice.

Chapter 61A deadlines are short, and without money already set aside the town may be unable to buy land in time; a dedicated acquisition fund would need town meeting approval to spend, so residents could be asked to vote on it.
